NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to wear a tiny lavastone chip as a necklace: wear it, or keep it in a pouch.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a tiny chip of lavastone, no bigger than a fingernail, and wants to wear it on a cord around (subject.his/her) neck. (friend) says even a chip has power, and wearing it day and night might do something strange. (subject) thinks a chip that small cannot do much. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) wears it. (subject.He/she) feels warmer, sleeps less, and becomes very good at finding lost things. (subject.He/she) also starts humming constantly without noticing. (friend) says that is the stone. (subject) says (subject.he/she) always hummed.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) keeps it in a pouch on (subject.his/her) belt. Nothing happens. Or perhaps nothing happens. On the night of the full moon, the pouch glows faintly. (subject) decides that is quite enough.
